metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in urban areas of Atlanta, Georgia increase in December 2013 compared to July 2013?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use NOAA VIIRS DNB Monthly composites for 2013: primary VCMSLCFG (stray-light corrected), fallback VCMCFG.
- Time windows: July 2013 [2013-07-01, 2013-08-01), December 2013 [2013-12-01, 2014-01-01).
- Location: Atlanta, GA city boundary from TIGER/2018/Places.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- VIIRS monthly composites are already cloud-free composites; no extra cloud masking. Focus on avg_rad band.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection size. If 0 after fallback => C1.
- Count valid pixels via Reducer.count on avg_rad. If 0 => C2.
- If mean is null/NaN/Infinity or unreasonable => C3.
- Otherwise compare Dec mean > Jul mean => A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // Helpers
    const getInfoAsync = (eeObj) =>
      new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo((v, e) => (e ? reject(e) : resolve(v))));

    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const places = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/Places')
      .filter(ee.Filter.and(
        ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Atlanta'),
        ee.Filter.eq('STATEFP', '13')
      ));
    const atlanta = ee.Feature(places.first());
    const atlGeom = ee.Algorithms.If(
      atlanta,
      ee.Feature(atlanta).geometry().buffer(1000), // small buffer to ensure coverage
      null
    );

    const hasGeom = await getInfoAsync(ee.Algorithms.IsEqual(atlGeom, null).not());
    if (!hasGeom) {
      console.log('Atlanta geometry not found.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const area_km2 = (await getInfoAsync(ee.Geometry(atlGeom).area(1))).valueOf() / 1e6;
    console.log(`Area (km2): ${area_km2.toFixed(1)}`);

    const periods = [
      { label: 'Jul2013', start: '2013-07-01', end: '2013-08-01' },
      { label: 'Dec2013', start: '2013-12-01', end: '2014-01-01' }
    ];

    // 2. Data Acquisition with Fallback
    async function fetchMonthlyImage(start, end, region) {
      const datasets = [
        { id: 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG', band: 'avg_rad', name: 'VCMSLCFG' },
        { id: 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG', band: 'avg_rad', name: 'VCMCFG' }
      ];
      for (const ds of datasets) {
        const col = ee.ImageCollection(ds.id)
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .filterBounds(region);
        const size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
        if (size > 0) {
          const img = ee.Image(col.first()).select(ds.band);
          // Validate band existence
          const bands = await getInfoAsync(img.bandNames());
          if (bands && bands.includes(ds.band)) {
            return { img, size, dataset: ds.name, band: ds.band };
          }
        }
      }
      return { img: null, size: 0, dataset: null, band: null };
    }

    const results = {};
    for (const p of periods) {
      const fetched = await fetchMonthlyImage(p.start, p.end, ee.Geometry(atlGeom));
      results[p.label] = fetched;
      const sizeStr = fetched.size || 0;
      console.log(`${p.label} Images: ${sizeStr} ${fetched.dataset ? '(' + fetched.dataset + ')' : ''}`);
    }

    // Check Empty Collection
    if (!results.Jul2013.img || !results.Dec2013.img) {
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing and Valid Pixel Counts
    async function regionStats(img, band, geom) {
      const countDict = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const meanDict = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const count = await getInfoAsync(countDict.get(band));
      const mean = await getInfoAsync(meanDict.get(band));
      return { count: count || 0, mean };
    }

    const julStats = await regionStats(results.Jul2013.img, results.Jul2013.band, ee.Geometry(atlGeom));
    const decStats = await regionStats(results.Dec2013.img, results.Dec2013.band, ee.Geometry(atlGeom));

    console.log(`Jul2013 Mean (nW/cm2/sr): ${julStats.mean !== null ? julStats.mean.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${julStats.count}`);
    console.log(`Dec2013 Mean (nW/cm2/sr): ${decStats.mean !== null ? decStats.mean.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${decStats.count}`);

    // 4. Handling No Valid Pixels
    if (julStats.count === 0 || decStats.count === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    function invalid(val) {
      return val === null || !isFinite(val);
    }
    if (invalid(julStats.mean) || invalid(decStats.mean)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = decStats.mean - julStats.mean;
    console.log(`Diff (Dec - Jul): ${diff.toFixed(3)} nW/cm2/sr`);

    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
